name: profile-settings
title: Profile Settings
description: User profile name editing, read-only email, and account deletion with typed confirmation, backed by the framework's profile service.

files.content:
import { Card } from "@/components/ui/card"; import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton"; export default function ProfileSettingsLoading() { return (
); }

{
  "page": {
    "title": "Profile",
    "description": "Manage your name, email, and account."
  },
  "form": {
    "generalTitle": "General",
    "generalDescription": "Update your name. Your email is managed by your login provider.",
    "avatarCaption": "Generated automatically from your name.",
    "nameLabel": "Name",
    "emailLabel": "Email",
    "emailNote": "Your email address can't be changed here.",
    "save": "Save changes",
    "savePending": "Saving…",
    "updated": "Profile updated"
  },
  "dangerZone": {
    "title": "Danger zone",
    "description": "Deleting your account schedules it for permanent removal and signs you out everywhere. This cannot be undone.",
    "trigger": "Delete account",
    "dialogTitle": "Delete account",
    "dialogDescription": "This will schedule your account for deletion and sign you out of every session. Type <token>{token}</token> to confirm.",
    "confirmLabel": "Type {token} to confirm",
    "cancel": "Cancel",
    "confirm": "Delete account",
    "confirmPending": "Deleting…",
    "deleted": "Your account has been scheduled for deletion"
  },
  "errors": {
    "forbidden": "You don't have permission to do that.",
    "providerError": "Something went wrong. Please try again.",
    "somethingWentWrong": "Something went wrong.",
    "invalidInput": "Invalid input"
  },
  "email": {
    "subject": "Your account has been scheduled for deletion",
    "heading": "Account deletion confirmed",
    "body": "Your account ({email}) has been scheduled for deletion.",
    "warning": "If this wasn't you, contact support right away."
  }
}
